title: MARS COLONY: Life Support Failed — You Have 2 Hours 🚀🔴
description:
What if your Mars habitat just lost oxygen? You have two hours to live. Ares Prime. Twelve people on board. CO2 scrubber failed. Backup's frozen. Help is eight months out.

Commander Voss grabs rover keys. Eight klicks to Backup Hab. Dr. Chen seals the greenhouse. Algae makes oxygen. Engineer Kovic checks his leaking suit. Surface cache is two klicks out.

Wait. The comms dish — boost the signal, Earth hears us today. Resupply launches in six weeks.

Here's the catch. Power for ONE. Rover motors. Greenhouse seals. Suit heaters. Comms array. Pick wrong, everyone dies in the dark.

Vote in comments:
A: Rover dash
B: Greenhouse gamble
C: Surface walk
D: Signal Earth

Next part opens with the oxygen winner.
